reviews.name: Kevin
reviews.disliked:
- The sounds are absurdly cartoonish and aren't subtle/intuitive like in minecraft
- The map doesn't go on forever like in actual minecraft
- I don't like the prebuilt house
- One of the things that minecraft is most known for is music. You HAVE to create and add calming relaxing music to this
- Controller support is halfway there. Analog sticks work. The A button to jump works. But none of the other buttons and triggers work like they would in a real game.
